agent-orchestrator.whatsNew: Send-CopilotPrompt.ps1 and Select-ChoicePromptOption.ps1 now wait for a quiet keyboard and mouse before taking the foreground, and hand the person's window back afterwards.

project-memory-management.whatsNew: The skills repo clone is found through %USERPROFILE%\.copilot\skills-source.json instead of a fixed C:\MyFiles\Git path.

project-memory-management-graph.whatsNew: Generated read-aloud pointers delegate ready-handoff timing to that skill instead of prescribing speech after replies; enabled push precedes enabled TTS and the ready handoff.

push-notifications.whatsNew: Distinguish server acceptance from phone delivery and offer optional user-confirmed receipt checks without automatic resends or changing notification consent.

ui-interaction.whatsNew: Adds user-activity helpers to AgentCursor.ps1: a quiet wait before taking the foreground, an amber waiting dot with a sound, an input lock, and a hand-back of the person's window and focus.

ui-navigation-orchestrator.whatsNew: The skills repo clone is found through %USERPROFILE%\.copilot\skills-source.json instead of a fixed C:\MyFiles\Git path.

vs-chat-history.whatsNew: Replaces experimental direct self-renaming with the bundled independent idle-handoff worker; other idle chats retain the direct UI route.

vs-copilot-chat-voice.whatsNew: Define explicit prototype handoffs and capability-gated production voice policy without claiming an available bridge or automatic response subscription.

vs-debug.whatsNew: Uses successful-build marker executable discovery and makes long-wait progress, timeout and cleanup reporting explicit without implying hardware progress or success.
